newsitem.title: FRANCE: US missile shot down TWA airliner - Salinger.
newsitem.headline: US missile shot down TWA airliner - Salinger.

text.p: Former White House adviser Pierre Salinger has said a U.S. Navy missile accidentally shot down a TWA airliner which crashed off New York last July, French radio said on Friday.
Radio France-Info quoted Salinger as saying he had received evidence that the U.S. missile caused the July 17 crash which killed all 230 people on board.
Salinger made his disclosure to airline officials meeting in the southern French resort of Cannes.
U.S. investigators have been unable to definitely establish the cause of the crash. A missile, a bomb aboard the plane or a technical incident have been among the possible causes mentioned.
No more details were immediately available on the comments by Salinger, a journalist who was an adviser to the late president John Kennedy.
